messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
messages.subject: Installing RStan on linux?
parts:
Hi,

Trying to install RStan on linux and the `install.R` script isn't
working for me. When I install RStan everything compiles but then I get
this message:

> installing to /opt/conda/lib/R/library/rstan/libs
> ** R
> ** inst
> ** preparing package for lazy loading
> ** help
> *** installing help indices
> ** building package indices
> ** installing vignettes
> ** testing if installed package can be loaded
> Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
> unable to load shared object '/opt/conda/lib/R/library/rstan/libs/rstan.so':
> /opt/conda/lib/R/library/rstan/libs/rstan.so: undefined symbol: _ZSt24__throw_out_of_range_fmtPKcz
> Error: loading failed

Are there any alternatives I should try? Will this perhaps be fixed by
RStan being on CRAN?

Thanks,

Allen

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Installing RStan on linux?
parts:
On Saturday, June 27, 2015 at 12:45:47 PM UTC-4, Allen B. Riddell wrote:
>   /opt/conda/lib/R/library/rstan/libs/rstan.so: undefined symbol: _ZSt24__throw_out_of_range_fmtPKcz
> Error: loading failed

Are there any alternatives I should try? Will this perhaps be fixed by
RStan being on CRAN?

CRAN won't help because R does installation from source outside of Windows and Mac. Did you build R from source or install it from a binary package in a repository? It works for me under Debian with either way.

Ben

messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
